name: tool-retrieval
title: Pick a few tools from a large registry, then answer with only those

origin.source: langgraph-bigtool and the LangGraph "many tools" how-to

comparison.purpose: Has Jev rate how likely each tool in a twelve-tool sample registry is to help with the question and keeps the three best above a threshold, then lets the model call one of them, ask for a new search, or answer. LangGraph enforces the selection by binding only the selected tools and bounds the loop with recursion_limit; here a guard rejects any tool outside the selected set, and MAX_TOOL_CALLS and MAX_RESELECTIONS are checked in guards so the model must answer or the run ends in failed.

starters: How many miles is a 42.195 km marathon?
How many days are there between 2026-01-15 and 2026-03-01?
What is the capital of Australia?
